description: Add an `httpStatus` member to the outputs of createServiceDomain and createWorkspaceDomainOwnership, bound to the HTTP response code. The spec is correct: it documents 201 when the call created the resource and 200 when it already existed (`POST /v1/services/{serviceId}/domains`: 200 "Custom domain already registered on this service"; `POST /v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/domain-ownerships`: 200 "The workspace already holds a domain ownership for the domain"). This is an SDK addition that exposes what the spec documents: the body is the same in both cases, so only the status tells the two apart. The member is required because the protocol sets it on every successful response.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The HTTP status of the last attempt: 201 when it created the resource, 200 when the resource already existed. After a retry, a resource this call created can come back with 200.
